task.pr_title: [PM-22344] - fix Error: Cannot Decrypt when moving a vault item to a collection

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: 💭  Using `false` here for `orgUseTotp` seems like it would break totp generation for ciphers after they're shared with an organization (at least until the vault re-syncs).

evidence.thread_resolution:
jaasen-livefront: @shane-melton Good point. I've pushed a fix. Looks like this is the only place we're calling `ShareManyAsync` so the change shouldn't have any side-effects elsewhere.
shane-melton: Sounds good, looks like we have some tests failing again though 😢
